rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a group of animals, or neutrally a group of people when the following noun supplies the context.

example.english: There is a herd of cows on the farm.
example.jyutping: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 ngau4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a crowd or mass of people rather than a neutral group of animals.

example.english: After the concert, the herd of concertgoers slowly dispersed.
example.traditional: 演唱會散場後，人群慢慢散去。
example.jyutping: jin2 coeng3 wui5 saan3 coeng4 hau6 jan4 kwan4 maan6 maan6 saan3 heoi3
